gaps.sentence: He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.

gaps.sentence: She's not as tall ___ her sister.
gaps.explanation: 'not as + adjective + as' for negative comparison.
'such an + adjective + singular noun' — 'interesting' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ , the match will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'unless' = if…not; present simple after time/condition words.

gaps.sentence: She made the cake ___, without any help at all.
gaps.explanation: 'She made it herself' — the reflexive stresses she did it alone.

gaps.sentence: He walked in as ___ nothing had happened.
By this time tomorrow, we ___ have finished the whole report.
gaps.explanation: 'By + future time' calls for the future perfect: will have finished.
